from storage_client import get_storage_client
from storage_models import UploadObjectRequest, UploadObjectResponse

def upload_object(
    request: UploadObjectRequest
) -> UploadObjectResponse:
    """Uploads a file or byte stream to Google Cloud Storage."""
    client = get_storage_client()
    bucket = client.bucket(request.bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(request.object_name)

    blob.upload_from_string(request.data, content_type=request.content_type)

    # Reload the blob to get updated metadata after upload
    blob.reload()

    return UploadObjectResponse(
        bucket_name=request.bucket_name,
        object_name=request.object_name,
        size=blob.size,
        md5_hash=blob.md5_hash, # Google Cloud Storage provides this
        crc32c_hash=blob.crc32c, # Google Cloud Storage provides this
        media_link=blob.media_link
    )

from storage_client import get_storage_client
from storage_models import PresignedDownloadRequest, PresignedDownloadResponse

def create_presigned_download_url(
    request: PresignedDownloadRequest
) -> PresignedDownloadResponse:
    """Creates a time-limited signed download URL for a Google Cloud Storage object."""
    client = get_storage_client()
    bucket = client.bucket(request.bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(request.object_name)

    # Generate the signed URL
    # The URL will be valid for the specified number of seconds
    signed_url = blob.generate_signed_url(expiration=request.expiration_seconds)

    return PresignedDownloadResponse(presigned_url=signed_url)

from storage_client import get_storage_client
from storage_models import ObjectMetadataRequest, ObjectMetadataResponse

def get_object_metadata(
    request: ObjectMetadataRequest
) -> ObjectMetadataResponse:
    """Reads object metadata from Google Cloud Storage."""
    client = get_storage_client()
    bucket = client.bucket(request.bucket_name)
    blob = bucket.blob(request.object_name)

    # Fetch the blob's metadata without downloading its content
    blob.reload()

    return ObjectMetadataResponse(
        bucket_name=request.bucket_name,
        object_name=request.object_name,
        size=blob.size,
        content_type=blob.content_type,
        md5_hash=blob.md5_hash,
        crc32c_hash=blob.crc32c,
        etag=blob.etag,
        time_created=blob.time_created.isoformat() if blob.time_created else None,
        updated=blob.updated.isoformat() if blob.updated else None,
        metadata=blob.metadata # Custom metadata if any
    )

from storage_client import get_storage_client
from storage_models import ListPrefixRequest, ListPrefixResponse

def list_objects_with_prefix(
    request: ListPrefixRequest
) -> ListPrefixResponse:
    """Lists stored objects under a Google Cloud Storage bucket or prefix."""
    client = get_storage_client()
    bucket = client.bucket(request.bucket_name)

    blobs = client.list_blobs(
        bucket_or_name=bucket,
        prefix=request.prefix,
        max_results=request.max_results
    )

    object_names = []
    for blob in blobs:
        object_names.append(blob.name)

    # The Google Cloud Storage client.list_blobs method handles pagination internally
    # when iterating, so we don't directly get a next_page_token in this simple iteration.
    # For more advanced pagination, one would use `versions=True` and `page_token` parameters.

    return ListPrefixResponse(
        objects=object_names,
        next_page_token=None  # Simplified; for full pagination, adjust the client call
    )

from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def translate_stored_text(
    text: str,
    target_language: str,
    project_id: str
) -> str:
    """Translates text extracted from a stored document using Google Cloud Translation API."""
    client = translate.Client(project=project_id)

    # Text can also be a sequence of strings, in which case this method
    # will return a sequence of results for each text. 
    # For this scenario, we assume a single text string.
    result = client.translate(text, target_language=target_language)

    return result["translatedText"]

from google.cloud import aiplatform

def summarize_stored_asset_content(
    text_content: str,
    project_id: str,
    location: str = "us-central1"
) -> str:
    """Summarizes content extracted from a stored asset using Google Cloud Vertex AI (text-bison model)."""
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)

    # Using the text-bison model for summarization
    # More information: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/generative-ai/model-reference/text
    parameters = {
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "max_output_tokens": 256,
        "top_p": 0.95,
        "top_k": 40
    }
    
    # Prepend a prompt for summarization
    prompt = f"Summarize the following text:\n\n{text_content}"

    model = aiplatform.TextGenerationModel.from_pretrained("text-bison")
    response = model.predict(prompt, **parameters)

    return response.text

from google.cloud import aiplatform
from typing import List

def embed_asset_metadata_and_text(
    texts: List[str],
    project_id: str,
    location: str = "us-central1"
) -> List[List[float]]:
    """Embeds object metadata and extracted text for search using Google Cloud Vertex AI (text-embedding-004 model)."""
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)

    # Using the text-embedding-004 model
    # More information: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/docs/generative-ai/model-reference/text-embeddings
    model = aiplatform.TextEmbeddingModel.from_pretrained("text-embedding-004")
    embeddings = model.get_embeddings(texts)

    return [embedding.values for embedding in embeddings]
